density.calculation_note: From the current S-OIL Lube Base Oil web page, 'Ultra-S Base Oil Typical Properties' table (undated, retrieved 2026-10-21). The archived 2009 sheet DL2-11177.pdf prints specific gravity 15/4 °C, which is not density; it is recorded separately in specific_gravity and not converted. Other values in this record come from archived documents; edition differences are listed in conflicts (2026-10 audit).

specific_gravity.calculation_note: 'Typical Properties' table, column 'Ultra-S 4' (p.1). Printed reference '15/4 °C' (no separate sample-temperature label); test_temperature_c left null. Not converted to density.

alternate_entries.calculation_note: SDS (p.2) prints 'RELATIVE DENSITY 0.834 @ 15 ℃' with no method and no water reference temperature; relative density is dimensionless and recorded as specific gravity. Not converted to density.

ccs.calculation_note: From the current S-OIL Lube Base Oil web page, 'Ultra-S Base Oil Typical Properties' table (undated, retrieved 2026-10-21); the archived 2009 sheet DL2-11177.pdf prints no CCS (2026-10 audit).

open_questions: S-OIL Ultra-S 4 SDS revised 2015-06-10 reports Distillates (petroleum), hydrotreated light paraffinic; CAS 64742-54-7; purity 100%. The printed description and CAS number appear inconsistent and require supplier clarification.
Specific gravity at 15/4°C is dimensionless and must not be transcribed directly as absolute density.
CCS for Ultra-S 4 is recorded in Tier 1 as 1,500 mPa.s at -30 °C (ASTM D5293) from the current S-OIL Lube Base Oil web page; the archived 2009 sheet DL2-11177.pdf prints no CCS (2026-10 audit).
Final source-level reconciliation between DL2-11177.pdf and SDS DL2-15139.pdf remains pending.

API Group (2026-10 audit): previously recorded as 'Group III' (Reported, no source; printed_text 'aramcoULTRA (Group III); S-OIL states Ultra-S and aramcoULTRA have the same properties'; note 'Classification supported by manufacturer-published Ultra-S/aramcoULTRA equivalence; not directly stated in the historical grade-specific SDS.'). No archived or public S-OIL document classifies Ultra-S 4 directly, so the field is now Missing. Indirect evidence only, not a classification of Ultra-S: (1) S-OIL states 'Ultra-S base oil is S-OIL's own brand product and has the same properties with armcoULTRA base oil' and lists identical typical properties for Ultra-S 4 and aramcoULTRA 4 (https://www.s-oil.com/en/energy/LubeBaseOil.aspx, undated, retrieved 2026-10-21); (2) the Aramco base-oil catalog 2024 p.25 lists aramcoULTRA 4 as API Base Oil Category Group III (https://www.aramco.com/-/media/downloads/creating-value/base-oils/aramco-base-oil-catalog-2024.pdf). Confirm the API Group of Ultra-S 4 with S-OIL.
